sources: Solvang Julefest 2026 (official visitor site): Nov 27, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027; Tree Lighting Fri Dec 4, 5:30 PM, Solvang Park (1630 Mission Dr); parade Sat Dec 5, 11 AM-1:30 PM, theme 'Nisser & Nordic Nights'; nightly 10-minute light & music shows in Solvang Park at 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM (New Year's Melodies Dec 26-Jan 3); Nisser Adventure Nov 27-Jan 3, clues at the Solvang Visitor Center; Santa's Village opens Sat Nov 28, weekends through Dec 20, 12-4 PM; Photos with Santa Paws Sat Dec 12, 10 AM-12 PM, free; museum crawl Sat Dec 12 with Elsa at the Hans Christian Andersen Museum 11 AM-12 PM; Elf The Musical Dec 11 and 12, 6 PM, Solvang Festival Theater; Copenhagen Countdown Thu Dec 31, 2-4 PM, countdown at 3 PM; tree burn Fri Jan 8, 2027, 5 PM

Solvang FAQ (official): parking is free throughout the village and at hotels; compact and walkable; 'Solvang Restaurant and Æbleskivehuset both serve them fresh' (round Danish pancakes with powdered sugar and raspberry jam); family photos in the Giant Red Clog; Sunny Fields Park castle; Julefest Nov 27, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027

Getting to Solvang (official): 125 miles up the coast from Los Angeles, downtown LA about two and a half hours; US-101 exit 140A for CA-246, three miles east; Amtrak Pacific Surfliner to Santa Barbara plus an Amtrak Connection bus into the village (sold with the train ticket, reservations required, two buses a day)
Solvang Restaurant, 1672 Copenhagen Dr: 'Home of Arne's Aebleskiver', famous for its Danish æbleskiver
Alisal Ranch, 1054 Alisal Rd, Solvang: a luxury guest ranch across 10,500 acres, for families, couples and multi-generational trips; December 2026 events listed
Alisal Ranch, horseback riding: 'riding horses along 50 miles of trails' (no riding ages published)
OpenStreetMap routing (OSRM): Alisal Ranch to Solvang Park, 2.8 miles by road
